purpose: Per-node waiver register for the pre-existing known-failure debt retained after the T7.2 repair chain, replacing any blanket PREEXISTING waiver per DEEP-CHECKIN-4 conditions.
ratifier_conditions: DEEP-CHECKIN-4 (Codex Sol mrc-34d493f6…): 'PREEXISTING-222 fail-at-both is not a ratifiable blanket waiver without per-node signatures' — satisfied here by per-node sha256 failure-line digests; 'the 26 fce-only greens belong in an annex, not a waiver table' — honored (see fce-only-greens-annex.json). SOL1-early adjudications restored the ratified T4.3 typed skip and isolated the cancellation-liveness test; those repaired nodes are NOT waived here.
method: No new test runs. Survivors derived mechanically: 443 classified failures minus CONTRACT-DRIFT-INTENTIONAL (97, repaired by T7.2e/g + SOL-FREEZE restores) minus ENVIRONMENTAL (86, hermetic ARNOLD_GENERATION_PYTHON fixtures + untracked-state handling) minus OURS-REGRESSION (38, T7.2f/f2) leaves the PREEXISTING class (222). Added: the 8 proven-pre-existing residual watchdog nodes (T7.1 inventory survivors still red at classification head: 7 in shard1 + 1 in shard9; the other 13 T7.1-inventory siblings flipped green via T7.1b). Signature digests are sha256 of each node's literal final failure line as recorded in the canonical stdout artifacts; the classification verified fail@both-identical signatures, and the disposable-clone fce sweep retained pass/fail lists but not per-node fce tracebacks, so the identical-signature hash stands for both baseline and head fields. needs-rerun-adjudication count: 0 (230/230 evidenced). Arithmetic: 443 = 97 + 86 + 38 + 222; retained = 222 + 8 = 230.
